body.heading: Where in the world is Saudi Arabia?
paragraphs: Saudi Arabia is a country in Western Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Saudi Arabia is Riyadh.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Saudi Arabia is Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Saudi Arabia is the Saudi riyal.

body.heading: How big is Saudi Arabia?
paragraphs: Saudi Arabia covers about 2,150,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about three times the size of Myanmar.

body.heading: A fact to wow your friends
paragraphs: The Arabian Peninsula contains the Rub’ al Khali, one of the largest sand deserts. Rub' al Khali means 'the Empty Quarter' — a sea of sand bigger than the whole country of France.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Hegra's tombs were carved into desert rock by the Nabataeans — the same people who built Petra. AlUla's oasis of palm groves and old mud-brick town sits among golden cliffs.
Al-Balad is Jeddah's historic heart, famous for tower houses with wooden lattice balconies called roshan, built by merchants of the Red Sea trade.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Saudi Arabia on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
